claims.statement: On the oriented C3 triangle cell complex with integer data, the primal quotient norm satisfies Phi_1 = 1 regardless of 2-cell attachment, while the degree-2 curvature defect Gamma_2 is undefined without a 2-cell and evaluates to 1 when a 2-cell is attached.

Discrete coboundary operators d0 and d1.
Primal l1 quotient norm minimization on C^1.

Gated readout requiring eval authorization for acceptance.
